final_architecture.name: Hybrid Architecture #3
final_architecture.design_rationale: Hybrid design keeping Patient, Appointment, Billing as stable services while offloading bursty workloads to serverless functions. Balances operational control with elasticity. Selected through 3 multi-agent evolutionary cycles, achieving a final multi-objective fitness of 82.0/100. Incorporates 12 components tailored for Healthcare management system with async messaging.
